blocks.text: ONCEs, get ready: Nayeon is back and bringing a whole new edge. TWICE’s lead vocalist Nayeon, will make her third solo comeback on Nov. 20. She will release her single album, “NA-sty.” JYP Entertainment announced the comeback across TWICE’s social media pages. This release marks her return after two years and five months. Her previous EP, NA, dropped in June 2024. READ: Nayeon of TWICE brings out 2nd solo EP The album title is a clever double entendre.
